title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
description: Google has released its latest Gemini model, marketing it as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity work.

title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
description: Flow Engineering, which is bringing AI agents to hardware design, also landed Roelof Botha as an angel investor and board member.

title: OpenAI’s Jev clone could help the frontier lab stop its swarming agents
description: OpenAI's "Decisions API" is a Jev clone that confirms the importance of fast, cheap intelligence.

title: AI voice startup ElevenLabs doubles valuation to $22B
description: The $300 million employee tender was co-led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price.

title: Reddit is killing RSS feeds and ending public API access because of AI bots
description: Reddit is ending support for RSS feeds, as the company continues tightening access to its trove of user-generated content.

title: The ugly economics of consumer AI
description: There’s a reason frontier labs have gotten gun-shy about consumer AI — and it’s not because the tech isn’t good enough.

title: Meta disputes claim that Muse read a user’s private messages without permission
description: Meta says its Muse AI agent cannot access a user’s Messages without explicit permission, disputing a journalist’s account that the agent read his private messages while the required Mac setting was turned off.

title: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
description: By launching an AI agent for food ordering, DoorDash is looking to gain an edge over rivals Uber Eats and Grubhub.

title: Destro AI’s secret sauce is getting robots and humans on the same page
description: "One of the biggest reasons we are winning against robotics companies is because we are not a robotics company."

title: Instinct’s new product recommendations are giving some users the ick
description: Instinct is rolling out human-curated product and travel recommendations, but some users aren’t happy about getting suggestions they never asked for.

title: Cerebras Systems’ Andrew Feldman on whether AI can keep scaling at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
description: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, Cerebras Systems CEO and co-founder Andrew Feldman will explore the growing demand for compute, energy, and infrastructure, how Cerebras is approaching those constraints differently, and what comes next if today’s AI hardware reaches its limits.

title: Restate lands $20M as the need for durable infrastructure increases with AI agents
description: Instead of building its durable execution engine on top of an external database, the company developed its own storage, replication, and redundancy layers. This architecture allows Restate to be exceptionally fast and lightweight.

title: 3 days left to exhibit: Turn visibility into your next opportunity at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
description: Three days left to exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Book by October 2 at 11:59 p.m. PT to showcase your startup to 10,000+ founders, investors, operators, and tech leaders.

title: Airbnb adds AI search, more social features
description: Airbnb is also launching new services such as meal delivery and laundry in select locations.

title: America.gov gets really weird when you ask it about Minecraft, but it’s not a glitch
description: For the sake of national security, it's a relief to learn that America.gov is not hallucinating to the point that it's penning lengthy poetry.

title: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch
description: Before OpenAI launched its new AI agent, Dots, on Tuesday, Elon Musk's xAI had already acquired the domain name "dot.com," which now redirects to the Grok chatbot download page.

title: OpenAI’s latest features take direct aim at the app store model
description: OpenAI is building out the pieces of an alternative to the traditional app store model, turning ChatGPT into a place where software can be discovered and used by people and AI agents alike.

title: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
description: The new round is anticipated to be the company's last before its delayed 2027 public debut.

title: Here’s why OpenAI is absent from Nvidia’s industry-wide effort to end rogue AI agents
description: OpenAI isn't a public supporter of Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, but it is privately working with Nvidia, TechCrunch has learned.
